report.summary: Chunk 3 of projection_worker.py: defines _ro_connect, _stored_specs, _stored_source_hashes, _stored_watermark, and a read-only view comment block with checkable claims.

handoff.purpose: Define read-only database access functions for projection index.

symbols.name: _ro_connect
symbols.note: Returns a read-only sqlite3 connection or None if db is :memory: or file doesn't exist.

symbols.name: _stored_specs
symbols.note: Returns list of EmbeddingSpec from embedding_indexes table, or empty list on error.

symbols.name: _stored_source_hashes
symbols.note: Returns set of source_hash strings from event_projections for a given index_id.

symbols.name: _stored_watermark
symbols.note: Returns JournalPosition from projection_watermarks for given index_id and journal_id, or None.

claims.text: These read the schema owned by ``embeddings.py`` through a separate read-only connection rather than reaching into ``EventVectorStore._conn``.
claims.why: The claim references external module 'embeddings.py' and class 'EventVectorStore._conn' which are not present in this chunk.

claims.text: They exist because there is no public "has this event already been projected?" API, and because ``--dry-run`` must be able to answer that question without creating the database.
claims.why: The claim references a '--dry-run' flag and an API not present in this chunk.

claims.text: Returns a read-only sqlite3 connection or None if db is :memory: or file doesn't exist.
claims.why: Code returns None for ':memory:' and if path doesn't exist, and opens with mode=ro.

claims.text: Returns list of EmbeddingSpec from embedding_indexes table, or empty list on error.
claims.why: Code returns empty list if conn is None or on sqlite3.Error, and builds list from rows.

claims.text: Returns set of source_hash strings from event_projections for a given index_id.
claims.why: Code selects source_hash and returns set of strings, empty set on error or None conn.

claims.text: Returns JournalPosition from projection_watermarks for given index_id and journal_id, or None.
claims.why: Code returns None if conn is None or on sqlite3.Error, otherwise fetches row.

observations.what: Function _stored_watermark fetches a row but never constructs a JournalPosition object; it returns the raw row (or None). The claim says it returns JournalPosition, but code returns the row as-is.
The comment block uses triple-backtick fences incorrectly; they are not Python docstrings but plain comments. Functions lack explicit docstrings.
